title: Stable native page swiping
summary: Primary screens now remain attached during gestures, carry their own top chrome, and preserve each tab's vertical position without blank handoff frames.
changes: Each primary screen now carries its own complete top chrome during horizontal movement, so Night no longer gains or loses its header after the page has already moved.
Incoming screens are previewed at their own saved vertical scroll position, eliminating the blank-screen jump that could appear when switching between tabs at different scroll depths.
The primary page width now includes the full screen gutters and the transition uses stable layout coordinates, keeping outgoing and incoming pages joined edge-to-edge throughout the gesture.
No roster calculation, Supabase, authentication, staffing-rule or clinical-workflow behavior changed.
